entry.title: LAB401: Return to standard operations 🎉
entry.content:
With COVID-19 restrictions eased in France, Lab401's logistics chain has resumed standard operations.

Specifically, this means:

  • Free shipping world-wide for orders over 50€
  • < 24 hour order processing
  • The ability to go outside and order a baguette

We're proud to have been able to continue service throughout quarantine lockdowns, and even happier to be back to full-scale operations.

In what will no doubt be a challenging period ahead, the entire team is here to assist in any way we can to get your business back to normal as soon as possible.

Steve,
on behalf of the Lab401 team 🐹

entry.title: Announcing Global Free Shipping & Lab401 Reseller Program
entry.summary:
At Lab401, we strive to continuously deliver high quality and great service to our customers.

As such, we are excited to start 2019 with the launch of two new features: Global Free Shipping and the Lab401 Reseller Program.

More
entry.content:
At Lab401, we strive to continuously deliver high quality and great service to our customers.

As such, we are excited to start 2019 with the launch of two new features: Global Free Shipping and the Lab401 Reseller Program.

Global Free Shipping is no longer a perk, but a necessity. Any orders over 50EU - the majority of our catalog - will immediately qualify for our rapid, fully tracked, international free shipping.

Under development for several months, the Lab401 Reseller Program makes our exclusive catalog and logistics available to everyone.

With attainable MOQs, discounts up to 40% and shipping from our EU or Asia warehouses, the Reseller Program is open to everyone.

For more information, please visit the dedicated Reseller Program page.

On behalf of the Lab401 team, we look forward to partnering with you in 2019.
